metadata.title: लुरकुड़िया: आदिवासी संस्कृति, भाषा और भविष्य | Lurkudia: Tribal Culture, Language and Future
metadata.description: In the heart of Lohardaga district, Jharkhand, a small village is witnessing a remarkable effort to revive the traditional institution of Dhumkudia, once central to the Oraon tribe's cultural fabric. This ancient institution, which served as a communal space for imparting wisdom, preserving traditions, and nurturing young minds, is now on the brink of disappearing. However, a dedicated group of villagers is breathing new life into Dhumkudia by blending its rich cultural heritage with modern education. The Main Bhi Bharat team visited this unique experimental school, where age-old tribal practices harmoniously coexist with contemporary learning, offering a glimpse into the past while equipping the next generation for the future.
